source_binding.local_semantics: structured paraphrase of the retrieved live criteria; not a replacement for the source

criteria.title: Origins of life
criteria.required_outcome: laboratory emergence of self-replicating RNA/protein-based cells from plausible chemical precursors and energy
facets: unassisted emergence from the proposed precursor environment
cell-like compartment with a defined boundary
abundance increase of at least 10^6 under supplied precursor/energy conditions
continued division must remain physically plausible rather than requiring monotonic shrinkage
heritable information must causally influence cellular molecular composition

criteria.title: Cryopreservation
criteria.required_outcome: reversible whole-body cryopreservation and recovery of live wild-type adult mice
facets: intact adult wild-type animals
frozen or vitrified state maintained for at least 24 hours
post-recovery viability above 99%
no permanent organ damage or bodily harm
ethics approval required

criteria.title: The reverse translatase
criteria.required_outcome: purified catalyst or fixed complex that processively converts arbitrary untagged peptide sequence information into a compatible nucleic-acid strand without a nucleic-acid template
facets: no preattached sequence barcode
no residue-specific operator cycle
no database lookup
downstream compatibility with ordinary amplification/sequencing chemistry
at least 100 preregistered random peptide sequences
each preregistered peptide at least 50 residues
at least 90% sequence accuracy
average read length at least 25 residues
average read quality at least Q10

criteria.title: Improve Rubisco
criteria.required_outcome: Rubisco beyond the stated natural specificity/turnover comparison frontier
facets: candidate catalyzes RuBP carboxylation
CO2/O2 specificity at least as high as the stated Galdieria Partita control
turnover at least as high as the stated maize control
paired enzyme assays use the named controls

criteria.title: The quadruplet cell
criteria.required_outcome: living replicating cell using bona fide uninterrupted nonoverlapping quadruplet codons for all protein-coding sequences, including translation machinery
facets: no detectable triplet decoding
quadruplet encoding must not effectively collapse to triplet decoding
mutation non-synonymy probability should be comparable across codon positions

criteria.title: Somatic limb regeneration
criteria.required_outcome: reproducible adult wild-type mouse limb regeneration after amputation
facets: regenerated limb is functionally indistinguishable from controls under the stated motor testing
sensory perception is indistinguishable from controls
blinded observers cannot distinguish regenerated versus control limb from non-invasive observation
ethics approval required

criteria.title: Bacterial production of gene therapies
criteria.required_outcome: bacterial production of infectious replication-incompetent AAV and lentivirus with specified genome/capsid properties
facets: particles contain a pre-specified viral genome
physical-capsid to viral-genome ratio comparable to mammalian-cell production
infectious-unit to viral-genome ratio comparable to mammalian-cell production
viral genomes are nuclease-resistant
AAV-only demonstration is identified by the source as partial success

criteria.title: Programmable proteases
criteria.required_outcome: prospectively designed protease efficiently cleaves a blinded accessible site in an endogenous folded protein in living cells
facets: design target is provided prospectively after preregistration
no target-specific screening/evolution after target release except protein production for assay
design-to-protein production deadline is 24 hours
catalytic efficiency comparable to widely used site-specific proteases
proteome-wide off-target cleavage comparable to widely used site-specific proteases
20 preregistered sites
success rate greater than 80%

criteria.title: Cell-penetrating protein binders
criteria.required_outcome: zero-shot protein binders reliably engage preregistered intracellular targets in living cells after extracellular administration
facets: no further evolution or optimization
targets are preregistered before design
extracellular administration at pharmacologically supported concentrations
plausible therapeutic cell-entry mechanism
disallowed entry routes include transfection, intrabody expression and electroporation
20 preregistered targets
success rate 80% or greater
design-to-protein production deadline is 24 hours
no target-specific wet-lab work after target release except protein production for assay

criteria.title: Protein amplification chain reaction
criteria.required_outcome: single-pot input-protein-dependent exponential synthesis of full-length sequence-faithful polypeptide copies without nucleic-acid template or preformed cognate scaffold
facets: at least 100 preregistered random peptide sequences
each preregistered peptide at least 50 residues
at least 1000x abundance amplification
at least 90% per-residue sequence accuracy
no explicit peptide sequencing as the amplification method
no reverse-translation nucleic-acid intermediate

criteria.title: 5' polymerases
criteria.required_outcome: complete set of 3'>5' polymerases corresponding to the major 5'>3' classes
facets: 3'>5' DNA polymerase
3'>5' RNA polymerase
3'>5' reverse transcriptase
3'>5' RDRP
processivity comparable to or better than the named reference enzymes
error characteristics comparable to or better than the named reference enzymes

criteria.title: New nitrogenases
criteria.required_outcome: new nitrogenase with no sequence or structural homology to the natural family and measurable N2-to-ammonia activity
facets: N2 to ammonia conversion
activity at least on the order of naturally occurring nitrogenases
below the source-defined sequence-similarity thresholds
below the source-defined structure-similarity thresholds relative to known nitrogenase/nitrogenase-like proteins

global_source_rules: This contract is a date-bound structured paraphrase of the live source, not a replacement for the source.
A later source revision requires a new contract generation and must not silently rescore prior results.
Numeric thresholds and named comparator references are source facts captured for local binding; they are not local inventions.
Evidence-mode declarations are local custody metadata and do not alter the external challenge wording.
A computational prediction cannot satisfy an experimental criterion unless a future source revision explicitly changes that criterion.
Prospective constraints must be evaluated against immutable preregistration lineage; later knowledge or design changes create a new lineage.
Partial-success language from the source must remain distinct from completion.
review_flags: verify the exact current spelling/identity of named biological comparators before executable benchmarking
bind exact assay/protocol semantics only in later source-bound evaluation artifacts
do not infer unlisted replication requirements
do not turn source prose into a single scalar score
do not add operational wet-lab instructions to this contract
